summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Pulsenmore Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing a strategic partnership with Ouma Health to integrate its home ultrasound platform into virtual maternity care. The press release describes a commercial collaboration, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. No financial terms, equity stakes, or structural changes are disclosed. The filing is a standard current report of a business development, and no special-situation category applies. The announcement is forward-looking and promotional in nature, lacking deal mechanics or board actions typical of transformative events.
